pīṇenta.p: [ pīṇa + ṇe + anta] (ti) Google Translate He who grows fat.

C: pīṇenta：[pr．p．of pīṇeti] gladdening； pleasing； satisfying； invigorating．

pīṇesi.cp: aor. of pīṇeti. gladdened; pleased; satisfied; invigorated.

C: pīṇesi：[aor．of pīṇeti] gladdened； pleased； satisfied； invigorated．

pīṇeti.cp: pīṇ + e. gladdens; pleases; satisfies; invigorates.
pīṇeti.p: [ pīṇa + ṇe + ti ] (kā, kri) Google Translate (1) Makes you fat. (2) Satisfying.

S: pīṇeti：[cf．piya，Sk．pṛṇeti] 喜ばす，満足させる．pp．pīṇita．cf．pīṇana 満悦，装飾．
D: Pīṇeti，（pīṇ + e），使喜悦，取悦，使满意，鼓舞。 【过】 pīṇesi。 【过分】 pīṇita。【独】 pīṇetvā。 【现分】 pīṇenta。（p227）
F: Pīṇeti，﹐高兴（to gladden），快乐（please，cheer），满意（satisfy），使强壮（to invigorate）。【过分】pīṇita。
Pīṇeti，（pīṇ+e），使喜悦，取悦，使满意，鼓舞，使清新。【过】pīṇesi。【过分】pīṇita。【独】pīṇetvā。【现分】pīṇenta。
C: pīṇeti：[pīṇ + e] gladdens； pleases； satisfies； invigorates．
P: Pīṇeti，[cp．Vedic prīṇāti，prī，see piya．The meaning in Pāli however has been partly confused with pī，pinvati （see pīna），as suggested by Bdhgh in DA．I，157：“pīṇentī ti pīṇitaṁ thāma-bal’ûpetaṁ karonti”] to gladden，please，satisfy，cheer； to invigorate，make strong，often in phrase （attānaṁ） sukheti pīṇeti “makes happy and pleases” D．I，51； III，130 sq．； S．I，90； IV，331； PvA．283：cp．DhsA．403 （sarīraṁ p．）．It also occurs in def．of pīti （pīṇayatī ti pīti） at Vism．143=DhsA．115．-- pp．pīṇita．（Page 461）
U: PĪṆETI：（pin+e） vui mừng，vừa lòng thỏa mãn，làm cho cường tráng [aor] piṇesi [pp] piṇita [abs] piṇetvā [prp] piṇenta
R:
pīṇeti：ပီဏေတိ （ကာ） （√ပီ+ဏေ）
ဖြိုးပြည့်စေ၏။ ပြောစေ၏။ နှစ်သက်စေ၏။

pīneti：ပီနေတိ （√ပီ）
နှစ်သက်စေ၏။ နှစ်သိမ့်စေ၏။ ပျို့စေ၏။
DOP: pīṇāti pīṇoti pr. 3 sg. [ S. prīṇāti], pleases; Sadd 493, 29 (pī pītiyaṃ: ~oti ~āti pīti piyo, Be so; Ee piṇoti piṇāti); — caus. pr. 3 sg. pīṇeti , ~ayati ( and pīneti, pīnayati) [ S. prīṇayati; but also associated with pīna, and S. √pī, √pīv], gladdens, pleases; satisfies; refreshes; invigorates, makes strong; D I 51, 15 (te tena attānaṃ sukhenti ~enti mātāpitaro sukhenti ~enti, Be, Ee so; Ce pīnenti; Se piṇenti; Sv 157, 28 : pīṇitaṃ thāmabalūpetaṃ karonti) ≠ S I 90, 27 ( Be, Ce, Ee ~eti; Ee pīneti; Se piṇeti) ≠ A III 45, 11 foll. (~eti; Mp III 252, 12 : pīnaṃ thūlaṃ karoti, Ce, Ee so; Be pīṇitam; Se pīṇaṃ); D III 130, 32 (ekacco bālo pāṇe vadhitvā attānaṃ sukheti ~eti); Ja III 313, 11* (laddho piṇḍo na ~eti kiso ten’ asmi vaṭṭaka; 313, 17´ : na tappeti); Vism 143, 14 (~ayatī ti pīti, sā … kāyacittapīṇanarasā, Be, Ce so; Ee pīṇāyatī ti; Se pīnayatī ti) = Sp 145, 6 ( Ce so; Be pinayatī ti; Ee, Se pīnayatī ti) = As 115, 28 ( Ce, Ee, Se so; Be piṇayatī ti); Sv 40, 22 (migapakkhīnaṃ pi cakkhūni ~ayati pag eva devamanussānaṃ); 626, 18 (dissamānā va cakkhūni ~ayati, Ee so; Be piṇayati; Ce pīnayati; Se milāyati) = Ps IV 227, 12 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pīnayati); Mp IV 178, 24 (seṭṭhissa cittaṃ na ~eti); As 403, 14 (susiniddhehi macchamaṃsādīhi sarīraṃ ~enti, Ce, Se so; Be sarīramaṃsaṃ ~enti; Ee pīnenti); Sadd 499, 16 (idaṃ pana hetukattuvasena pīnayatī ti pīti, tappetī ti attho); — part.pr. pīṇenta, mfn. , Pv-a 283, 17 (attānaṃ sukhento ~ento); Ap-a 518, 8 (santappayanto ~ento); — aor. 3 sg. pīṇesi, Ja III 145, 4´ (taṃ kathaṃ idaṃ sāmākanīvāraṃ aloṇaṃ ~esi tosesi, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se ~eti toseti); Bv-a 216, 18 (tappayī ti atappayi, ~esī ti attho); — inf. pīṇetuṃ, M II 191, 28 (kāyaṃ c’ eva ~etuṃ brūhetuṃ); — pp pīṇita , mfn. [ S. prīṇita], pleased, gladdened; satisfied; invigorated, made strong; Vv 16:13 (muditaman’ amhi ~ā; Vv-a 86, 5 : tuṭṭhā pītirasavasena vā tittā); Pv 20:7 (yadi atthi hetu yena tuvaṃ cirataraṃ ~o siyā); Ja V 311, 20* (~ā tena lābhena tuṭṭhā; 311, 28´ : ~ā ti santappitā); Mil 249, 14 (subhuttā tittā suhitā dhātā ~ā paripuṇṇā); Vism 365, 15 ; Sv 157, 28 (pīṇentī ti ~aṃ thāmabalūpetaṃ karonti); Ps II 238, 23 (tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ balavasomanassavasena cittaṃ ~aṃ hoti); Paṭis-a 545, 33 (pītiyā ~-ttā kāyacittapassaddhi uppajjati); Mhv 18:59; — pīṇitabhojana- in Ee at Mp V 28, 23 is wr for paṇītabhojana- ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — ~’-indriya, mfn. , with invigorated, perfect sense-faculties; with senses in good condition; M II 121, 21 (bhikkhū passāmi haṭṭhapahaṭṭhe … ~’-indriye Ce, Ee so; Be pīṇindriye; Se piṇindriye); Dhp-a IV 11, 7 (sañjātabalo ~’-indriyo, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pīṇindriyo); Pv-a 23, 11 (te tāni paribhuñjitvā ~’-indriyā ahesuṃ, Ce so; Be, Ee pīṇindriyā; Ee pi nindiyā); 46, 6 (sā petī suhitā ~’-indriyā dibbāhārassa tittā ahosi, Ce, Ee pīṇindriyā); Ja I 81, 28 (samaṇo Gotamo paccayabāhullāya āvattitvā paripuṇṇakāyo ~’-indriyo suvaṇṇavaṇṇo hutvā āgacchati, Ce so; Be pīṇindriyo; Ee phītindriyo; Se piṇindriyo) = Ap-a 86, 20 ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pīṇindriyo); Mhv 37:168 (ñatvā taṃ … sukhitaṃ ~’-indriyaṃ); — see also pīnindriya ( sv pīna ); — atipīṇita, mfn. , in too good condition; Dhp-a I 70, 19 (atipīṇitaṃ etaṃ rūpaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se atipaṇītaṃ); — supīṇita, mfn. , very pleased, very glad; Ap 477, 9 ; — fpp pīṇetabba, mfn. , M II 186, 27 (ayaṃ ca kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo ti); Cp-a 162, 24 (attā pīṇetabbo); — see also pināti.
